title: The generic walk, on a small fixture
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::util::Tree
output application/json
---
mapLeafValues({a:{b:'x'},c:['y']}, (v,p) -> upper(v as String))

solution:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::util::Tree
output application/json
---
mapLeafValues({a:{b:'x'},c:['y']}, (v,p) -> upper(v as String))

explanation.approach: One leaf is two objects deep (`a.b`), the other is inside an array (`c[0]`). Both get the callback. That is the walk this module gives you for free.
